applicable_cases.m43_sql:
SELECT pol.product_id, SUM(pol.ordered_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty), 0) AS quantity_ordered_not_yet_received
FROM purchase_order_lines AS pol
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.po_line_id = pol.po_line_id
GROUP BY pol.product_id
HAVING COUNT(pol.po_line_id) > 0
applicable_cases.m45_sql:
SELECT pol.product_id, SUM(pol.ordered_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty), 0) AS quantity_ordered_not_yet_received
FROM purchase_order_lines AS pol
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.po_line_id = pol.po_line_id
GROUP BY pol.product_id
HAVING SUM(pol.ordered_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty), 0) > 0

negative_controls.m43_sql:
SELECT a.severity, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.investigation_id IS NOT NULL)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS investigation_fraction
FROM alerts AS a
LEFT JOIN investigations AS i ON i.alert_id = a.alert_id
GROUP BY a.severity
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
negative_controls.m45_sql:
SELECT a.severity, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.alert_id IS NOT NULL)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS investigation_fraction
FROM alerts AS a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT alert_id FROM investigations) AS i ON i.alert_id = a.alert_id
GROUP BY a.severity
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
